chapter.heading: Psalm 7
In You Do I Take Refuge
A Shiggaion(1) of David, which he sang to the LORD concerning the words of Cush, a Benjaminite.

my God,,

lest like
a lion,
they tear my soul apart, rending it in pieces, with none to deliver.

if I
have repaid,
my friend(2) with evil or plundered my enemy without cause,

let the
